planets.name: GJ 1252 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 1252 with a 0.518-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: GJ 1252 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around GJ 1252. Its orbit and size follow Shporer et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
